apps.localizedDescription:
AI Agent · Boundaries · CLI ·.

Community ·.

It used to take six or seven services, six or seven configs, and a lot of effort to keep them all agreeing about the same library. Now it's just MovieClaw:

All-in-one has its trade-offs, and they're laid out honestly in Boundaries.

Native apps, with playback that rivals Infuse:

Watch right in your browser, or in native apps on your phone, TV, and Mac. iPhone, Apple TV, and Mac share one playback engine of its own: FFmpeg unpacks, Apple plays.

• Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos; 4K HDR and Blu-ray disc rips play directly.
• Hardware decoding first, software decoding as the fallback, and transcoding only as a last resort.

iPhone and iPad 0.12.5: Back navigation keeps the composer clear:

When you swipe back from an AI conversation, the composer now stays above the returning glass tab bar instead of slipping behind it.

Fixed:

• During an edge swipe back from an AI conversation or the new-conversation page, the composer stays above the bottom glass tab bar while both are on screen. Cancelling the swipe returns the composer to its original position. Sidebars and top tab bars on wider iPad layouts are unchanged.
